Alles im Blick – mit „Einrichtung abschl: Everything at a glance – “Finish setup” starts NetScope.
Angemeldet als {name}. Der Assistent arb: Signed in as {name}. From now on the wizard continues with this account.
Auswertende Plugins (CVE-Abgleich, OUI-H: Evaluating plugins (CVE matching, OUI vendors, changes, topology, cleanup …) stay active. SSH inventory and SNMP need credentials and follow in the next step. Schedules and scope can be changed per plugin later.
Dafür ARP-Scan oder ICMP-Ping bei den Sc: Select ARP scan or ICMP ping among the scanners for this.
Das Konto des Administrators ist schon a: The administrator account exists already. Sign in to continue the setup.
Das Konto erhält die Rolle Administrator: The account gets the role Administrator. “Create account” creates it and signs you in; then you can set up TOTP.
Das erste Konto verwaltet NetScope als A: The first account manages NetScope as administrator.
Der Master-Key kommt aus der Umgebungsva: The master key comes from the environment variable NETSCOPE_MASTER_KEY. Without it stored credentials are lost – please keep it safe.
This instance works on its own.
Diese Instanz ist noch nicht eingerichte: This instance is not set up yet. So that only you take it over, a setup code is in the NetScope log and in the file data/setup-code.txt on the host.
This instance delivers to a central instance.
Diese Instanz liefert an {url} (NETSCOPE: This instance delivers to {url} (NETSCOPE_CENTRAL_URL). The connection cannot be changed here.
Dieses Subnetz ist schon in der Liste: This subnet is already in the list
Ein Code aus einer Authenticator-App sch: A code from an authenticator app protects the account in addition. Passkeys can be added later under System → Account.
Einzelne Adressen (oder Netze), die kein: Single addresses (or networks) no scanner probes – e.g. sensitive devices such as older printers or controllers.
Findet die Geräte in den gewählten Netze: Finds the devices in the chosen networks right away instead of waiting for the first schedule.
Für Zeitpläne, Berichte und Datumsangabe: For schedules, reports and dates. Suggestion: the time zone of this browser.
Gleich einen ersten ARP-Scan und Ping st: Start a first ARP scan and ping right away
Hostname oder IP, optional mit Port: Host name or IP, optionally with port
In welcher Sprache und Zeitzone arbeitet: In which language and time zone does NetScope work?
Kein angeschlossenes Netz erkannt – bitt: No attached network detected – please add a subnet below.
Leases und Reservierungen eines Windows-: Leases and reservations of a Windows DHCP server come from the NetScope agent for Windows. Install it on the DHCP server after the setup under Agents.
Leer = DNS-Server des Systems ({servers}: Empty = the system's DNS servers ({servers}). The router usually knows the names from DHCP best.
Leer = DNS-Server des Systems. Meist ken: Empty = the system's DNS servers. The router usually knows the names from DHCP best.
Läuft diese Instanz allein, als Zentrale: Does this instance run on its own, as a central instance or as a site of a central instance?
Nach dem Abschluss laufen {n} Scanner na: After finishing, {n} scanners run on their schedules; everything can be changed later under Plugins and System.
Nach dem Abschluss läuft {n} Scanner nac: After finishing, {n} scanner runs on its schedule; everything can be changed later under Plugins and System.
NetScope ist eingerichtet – der erste Sc: NetScope is set up – the first scan is running.
NetScope scannt nur die ausgewählten Net: NetScope scans only the selected networks. Detected are the networks directly attached to this host.
Nur für selbstsignierte Zertifikate der: Only for self-signed certificates of the central instance.
Router, Controller und Server kennen Nam: Routers, controllers and servers know names, addresses and connections a scan does not see. This step is optional – everything can be set up later under Plugins.
So heißt diese Instanz in der Standortau: The name of this instance in the site selector next to the sites.
Sprache der Oberfläche für dein Konto so: Language of the interface for your account and of notifications and reports. Both can be changed later.
Standorte liefern ihre Geräte und Events: Sites deliver their devices and events here.
Unter dieser Adresse erreichen Benutzer: The address users reach NetScope at – for links in notifications, the agent install command and passkeys. Suggestion: the address you opened.
Verbunden – die Zentrale kennt diesen St: Connected – the central instance knows this site as “{name}”.
Welche Netze soll NetScope kennen und sc: Which networks should NetScope know and scan?
Welche Scanner sollen von Anfang an lauf: Which scanners should run from the start? None runs before the setup is finished.
Welche Systeme soll NetScope mit Zugangs: Which systems should NetScope read with credentials?
Wird in der Zentrale beim Anlegen des St: Shown in the central instance when the site is created.
Zugangsdaten verschlüsselt NetScope mit: NetScope encrypts credentials with the master key in this file. Without it, stored credentials are lost after a restore – please keep it safe:
http(s)-URL der Zentrale erwartet: http(s) URL of the central instance expected
keines – Scanner finden ohne Subnetz nur: none – without a subnet, scanners only find the attached networks
Über Router erreichbare Netze scannt Net: Networks reached through a router are scanned without ARP (no MAC addresses). Set up WireGuard tunnels after the setup under System → Subnets.
„{value}“ ist weder IP-Adresse noch CIDR: “{value}” is neither an IP address nor a CIDR
